title: London-based Xapien, which uses AI for background checks and due diligence, raised a $56M Series B led by Spectrum Equity (Lucinda Shen/Axios)
summary: Lucinda Shen / Axios: London-based Xapien, which uses AI for background checks and due diligence, raised a $56M Series B led by Spectrum Equity — Xapien, an AI background check and due diligence company, raised $56 million in Series B funding led by Spectrum Equity, CEO Chris Green tells Axios Pro exclusively.
